titles.title: SAFE Rural Act
SAFE Rural Act
Sustainable and Flood Resilient Engineering for Rural Areas Act

To amend section 203 of the Robert T. Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act to establish within the Building Resilient Infrastructure and Communities program a dedicated rural flood resilience supplemental allocation providing formula-based pass-through grants to rural communities through a set-aside from the Federal Emergency Management Agency Disaster Relief Fund, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure.
